description: Wire SentinelAutoRotate into the Sentinel installer and build pipeline: an UNCHECKED-by-default opt-in task in setup.iss ([Tasks]/[Files]/[Run]/uninstall) and a publish\autorotate step in build.ps1. Also perform the decoupling verification. Depends on FEAT-001 (the exe and project must exist for the publish and [Files] paths to be valid). Keep edits minimal and consistent with each file's existing style. Do NOT modify release.ps1 or bump version.txt.
steps: installer/setup.iss [Tasks]: add a new [Tasks] section with ONE entry Name: "autorotate" and Flags: unchecked, with a Description that warns it enables Windows autologon and stores a machine-recoverable credential (reducing at-rest security) and that the account password becomes random and unknown. Example Description text: 'Enable SentinelAutoRotate (rotates this PC local account password to a random value every 10 minutes and turns on Windows autologon). The password becomes unknown to everyone and a machine-recoverable logon credential is stored, lowering at-rest security. Leave unchecked unless you specifically want this.'

installer/setup.iss [Files]: after the existing agent publish line add  Source: "..\publish\autorotate\SentinelAutoRotate.exe"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion  (path must match build.ps1 output from the step below).

installer/setup.iss [Run]: after the existing Sentinel.Service --install line (i.e. after file copy) add  Filename: "{app}\SentinelAutoRotate.exe"; Parameters: "--install"; Tasks: autorotate; Flags: runhidden waituntilterminated; StatusMsg: "Configuring SentinelAutoRotate..."  so it runs only when the task is selected.

installer/setup.iss CurUninstallStepChanged / usUninstall: BEFORE files are deleted, following the existing FileExists + Exec(..., ewWaitUntilTerminated, ResultCode) pattern, add: if FileExists(ExpandConstant('{app}\SentinelAutoRotate.exe')) then Exec(ExpandConstant('{app}\SentinelAutoRotate.exe'), '--uninstall', '', SW_HIDE, ewWaitUntilTerminated, ResultCode); Do NOT change AppVersion/VersionInfo/version.txt.

installer/build.ps1: after the Agent publish block (and before the icon/version.txt step) add a framework-dependent Release publish of tools/Sentinel.AutoRotate into publish\autorotate, matching the existing style: $AutoRotateProj = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\tools\Sentinel.AutoRotate\Sentinel.AutoRotate.csproj"; $AutoRotateOut = Join-Path $PublishDir "autorotate"; & $Dotnet publish $AutoRotateProj -c Release -f net48-windows -o $AutoRotateOut; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "AutoRotate publish failed" }. The existing publish/ clean already covers the new subfolder; the \tools\ version-stamp skip already excludes this csproj.

Decoupling verification: confirm Sentinel.AutoRotate.csproj has no ProjectReference; confirm no Core/Service/Agent/Tests csproj references Sentinel.AutoRotate; grep the src/ tree for 'AutoRotate' and confirm there is no DI registration, MonitorGroup entry, or detection-rule reference (the only references to the tool should be in installer/setup.iss and installer/build.ps1).
acceptance_criteria: setup.iss has a [Tasks] entry named 'autorotate' with Flags: unchecked and a warning Description.
setup.iss [Files] ships ..\publish\autorotate\SentinelAutoRotate.exe to {app}; the source path matches build.ps1's output dir.
setup.iss [Run] runs {app}\SentinelAutoRotate.exe --install only when Tasks: autorotate, after file copy, with runhidden waituntilterminated and a StatusMsg.
setup.iss usUninstall calls {app}\SentinelAutoRotate.exe --uninstall if it exists, before files are deleted.
build.ps1 publishes Sentinel.AutoRotate into publish\autorotate as Release net48-windows.
grep for 'AutoRotate' under src/ returns no product-code references (no ProjectReference, DI, MonitorGroup, or detection rule).
verification: & "C:\Program Files\dotnet\dotnet.exe" build e:\Gorstak\Sentinel\.worktrees\autorotate/Sentinel.sln -c Debug  -> 0 errors (confirms edits did not break the solution)

& "C:\Program Files\dotnet\dotnet.exe" test e:\Gorstak\Sentinel\.worktrees\autorotate/tests/Sentinel.Tests/Sentinel.Tests.csproj  -> no new failures beyond the 2 pre-existing TlsCertificateMonitorTests failures
grep -r AutoRotate e:\Gorstak\Sentinel\.worktrees\autorotate/src  -> no matches (decoupling confirmed); references appear only in installer/setup.iss and installer/build.ps1
findings:
Implemented. Changed only installer/setup.iss and installer/build.ps1.

setup.iss:
- [Files]: added 'Source: "..\publish\autorotate\SentinelAutoRotate.exe"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion' right after the agent publish line (path matches build.ps1 output dir publish\autorotate).
- New [Tasks] section (placed between [Files] and [Icons], Inno-order-agnostic): single entry Name: "autorotate"; Flags: unchecked; with the warning Description from the feature spec (random password every 10 min + autologon, machine-recoverable credential lowers at-rest security, leave unchecked).
- [Run]: added 'Filename: "{app}\SentinelAutoRotate.exe"; Parameters: "--install"; Tasks: autorotate; Flags: runhidden waituntilterminated; StatusMsg: "Configuring SentinelAutoRotate..."' right after the Sentinel.Service --install line (after file copy), gated on the task.
- CurUninstallStepChanged usUninstall: added FileExists+Exec('--uninstall', SW_HIDE, ewWaitUntilTerminated, ResultCode) at the START of the usUninstall block, BEFORE service/agent teardown and before files are deleted, reusing the existing ResultCode var.

build.ps1:
- Added a '3-AutoRotate' block after the Agent publish block (step 3) and before the icon/version.txt step (3a): publishes ..\tools\Sentinel.AutoRotate\Sentinel.AutoRotate.csproj -c Release -f net48-windows -o publish\autorotate, with 'if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "AutoRotate publish failed" }'. The existing publish/ clean at step 1 covers the new subfolder; the \tools\ regex skip already excludes this csproj from version stamping.

Unchanged (as required): AppVersion/VersionInfo/version.txt, release.ps1.

Decoupling verified: Sentinel.AutoRotate.csproj has NO ProjectReference; no Core/Service/Agent/Tests csproj references the tool; grep src/ for 'AutoRotate' returns 0 matches. Only installer/setup.iss and installer/build.ps1 reference the tool (plus the tool's own csproj RootNamespace/AssemblyName).

Verification: full solution Debug build = 0 errors (SentinelAutoRotate.exe built). dotnet test = total 2567, failed 2, succeeded 2565 — the 2 failures are the known pre-existing TlsCertificateMonitorTests (AnalyzeCert_LongLivedSelfSignedRoot_MissingCrl_NotScored, AnalyzeCert_SelfSigned_Alone_DoesNotIncreaseConfidence), no new failures. Did not run installer/build.ps1 (needs Inno Setup + signing); installer edits verified by read-back + solution build.
